item.title: Releases, Search and Mobile Text Polish
item.description: The Releases section now labels emulator links as Emuladores and removes duplicates.

item.title: Piracy Polish: Hashtags, Audio Control Restored, Clickable Images
item.description: The Piracy section has been refined with hashtag improvements, restored audio controls and clickable images.

item.title: Final Layout and Media Adjustments
item.description: The navigation retains Releases, Piracy and Flix links while the FAQ link and footer have been removed. Comments, subscribe and support boxes remain at the top of the left sidebar. A back-to-top arrow floats at the bottom centre of the page for easier navigation.

item.title: Dark Header, Flix Nav and Media Fixes
item.description: The top bar is now black with white text and includes Releases, Piracy and Flix tabs. The sidebar content, including subscribe, comments and support, stays at the top of the left column. A back-to-top arrow appears when scrolling.

item.title: Header Redesign
item.description: A new link was added to the Releases section. The header now displays the tagline “The ONLY official site for Software FXC” on the left, with Releases, Piracy and FAQ navigation links and the search button aligned on the right.

item.title: Multimedia Changes
item.description: The latest release now includes a screenshot, and a video has been added.

item.title: Section Branding
item.description: Header branding now changes by section while Flix videos remain embedded.

item.title: Search
item.description: Header and Enter-key search behavior were updated.

item.title: Embed Layout Fixes
item.description: Drive embeds, search styling and responsive video layout were adjusted.

item.title: Flix and Piracy
item.description: Flix is now its own section, with fandom videos.

item.title: Releases
item.description: The Releases section now includes download notes, extra links and updated labels.

item.title: Emulator Catalog
item.description: The emulator catalog now includes official project links.

item.title: FAQ
